name: Cristina D'Alessandro
bio:
I’m Cristina D’Alessandro, an Italian photographer and videographer.

My background is rooted in visual arts, with a degree in Photography from the Academy of Fine Arts. My artistic journey has taken me through different creative environments and international experiences, allowing me to broaden my perspective and develop my photographic practice.

My work explores the relationship between photography, visual storytelling and creative expression.

I’m constantly developing my visual language and exploring new ways to communicate through images and film.

I’m always open to new collaborations, creative projects and opportunities to bring ideas to life.
statement: Every image starts with people, places and the stories behind them.
